item.title: Toshiue Kanojo
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Azarashi Soft
  • 発売日: 2024-11-29
  • スコア: 6.4799999999999995/10 (61 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 年上彼女
  • 英語名: Toshiue Kanojo

别名

  • An Older Girlfriend

あらすじ

“Oh, come on……Hurry it up……!”

Says the protagonist, Kamiki Reo, while waiting impatiently for the traffic lights to change. Today, there is no morning practice for his track and field club, however, after helping an old lady in trouble, before he knows it, the class is about to start.

Using the unusual traffic lights as his starting line, he manages to make it in time…… But when he plunges into the school gate, he accidentally bumps into someone and pushes them down.

别名

  • 甜蜜夏日+

あらすじ

A simple coming-of-age story about falling in love in the countryside during summer.

Having lived in the city for a long time, the protagonist suddenly moves to the countryside and falls in love with a girl.

While such daily life continues, summer is coming to an end and the time for the Nanakayama school festival approaches.

item.title: Amakano 2+
item.description:

  • 日本語名: アマカノ２＋
  • 英語名: Amakano 2+

あらすじ

About half a year has passed since “Amakano 2”, sets in autumn. As the seasons change, and summer approaches, a new love story is about to begin.

Showing her true self as a matter of course, Yuuhi is now able to spend her age-appropriate youth together as lovers.

Despite aiming for affection straightforwardly as a lover, becoming interested in her classmates, Rei’s world around her has expanded a little.

item.title: Amaemi -longing for you-
item.description:

  • 英語名: Amaemi -longing for you-

あらすじ

The protagonist, Nabeshima Tatsuya, was a world-renowned painter.

However, after a certain incident, he disappeared from the public eye.

Now as a social studies teacher, he spends his days away from the art world.

He lives in seclusion with his cat in his social studies preparation room, which is his own residence, away from the public eye.

item.title: Toshishita Kanojo
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Azarashi Soft
  • 発売日: 2021-06-25
  • スコア: 7.4/10 (64 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 年下彼女
  • 英語名: Toshishita Kanojo

あらすじ

“When I grow up, I’m going to marry you, Onii-chan!”

This kind of promise is the least likely to be kept in the world.

At least, the protagonist, Yunagimoto Yuusuke, believed as much when he thought back on the distant memory of that promise.

Then, one day, a younger female relative of his showed up at the apartment where he was living alone and said “I’m old enough to get married now. Will you keep your promise and take me as your wife?”

item.title: Aikagi 3
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Azarashi Soft

  • スコア: 6.890000000000001/10 (120 人評価)
  • 日本語名: アイカギ３
  • 英語名: Aikagi 3

あらすじ

“She is here again, huh…?”

Sighing, our protagonist, Yuuto, put the key to his house that he just took out back into his pocket without using it. Upon entering, he found his childhood friend, Saotome Ai, fiddling with her phone, relaxing as if it were her own house. The spare key (AIKAGI) to the house was hanging from her neck.

item.title: Osananajimi no Iru Kurashi
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Azarashi Soft
  • 発売日: 2021-04-30
  • スコア: 6.95/10 (67 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 幼馴染のいる暮らし
  • 英語名: Osananajimi no Iru Kurashi

あらすじ

Spring——the season of exciting new encounters.

In this warm season of beginnings, Aikawa Kazuki has made a decision.

He will express his feelings to his childhood friend, Sakurazawa Mayuki. The girl has been like family to him since before he can remember, cooking meals for him in the place of his frequently absent parents. He’s never been able to take the first step to advance their relationship, but today is the day. With that in mind, Kazuki calls Mayuki into the classroom after school and tells her how he feels.

あらすじ

“It’s hot…”

Summer is just around the corner. Tokizaki Youichi’s air conditioner chose such a timing for it to broke down. It would take quiet a while to repair, so it seems, and as such he’s at his wits end. While he is at a loss for what to do, his childhood friend Misora Saku, who is staying in the next room over, makes an unexpected suggestion.

item.title: Amakano 2
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Azarashi Soft
  • 発売日: 2020-04-24
  • スコア: 8.190000000000001/10 (682 人評価)
  • 日本語名: アマカノ２
  • 英語名: Amakano 2

あらすじ

When something new begins, it tends to do so suddenly and unexpectedly.

Returning from the countryside on the bullet train, a girl, Kurohime Yuuhi, is assigned the seat next to you.

You learn that a cousin you have barely spoken to, Himiyama Rei, is going to be living with you.

These two encounters, along with your childhood friend, Tsutamachi Chitose, who lives next door and is older than you, will, like the changing color of the autumn leaves, bring color to your heretofore unchanging life.

item.title: Aikagi 2
item.description:

  • 発売日: 2019-04-26
  • スコア: 7.17/10 (191 人評価)
  • 日本語名: アイカギ2
  • 英語名: Aikagi 2

あらすじ

It is spring.

It’s a wonderful start of the new semester for our protagonist— or so it should have been, until the homeroom teacher suddenly summoned him out of the blue.

It seems that his childhood friend, Ayano Sumeragi, hasn’t been going to school this semester. “Did something happen to her?” wondered our protagonist with anxiety.

item.title: Aibeya
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Azarashi Soft
  • 発売日: 2019-02-22
  • スコア: 7.05/10 (159 人評価)
  • 日本語名: アイベヤ
  • 英語名: Aibeya

あらすじ

“Starting from tomorrow, you’ll be staying at Aki’s place”

After Kouta’s mother suddenly said that, he ended up living with his childhood friend Aki. Being together with her all the time, he developed some feelings for her. However, he did not know if it was ‘love’.

“Then, how about we try being lovers?”

A trial period as lovers under the same roof. Are they just childhood friends, or something else…?

item.title: Aikagi ~After Days~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Azarashi Soft
  • 発売日: 2018-01-26
  • スコア: 7.1/10 (181 人評価)
  • 日本語名: アイカギ ～アフターデイズ～
  • 英語名: Aikagi After Days

あらすじ

Nozomu and his childhood friend Shiori became lovers after the Christmas confession. They had been attending the same university since the following spring, and then their first summer as a couple arrived. Despite being childhood friends, they had not spent their summer vacations together for a while. Nozomu proposed that they make plans to fully enjoy this summer to make up for all their past years apart, and Shiori readily went along with it.

item.title: Aikagi
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Azarashi Soft
  • 発売日: 2017-01-27
  • スコア: 6.659999999999999/10 (537 人評価)
  • 日本語名: アイカギ
  • 英語名: Aikagi

あらすじ

It was the last winter of his school life and with entrance exams and graduation edging closer, Nozomu didn’t know what to do. He was told to become independent, but he couldn’t find a suitable place to live by himself. His childhood friend Shiori couldn’t stand watching him in his current state and suggested that he live with her. While he thought that it wouldn’t really make him independent, his parents readily agreed to the idea. Before he knew it, they were living together under the same roof.

item.title: Amakano ~Second Season~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Azarashi Soft
  • 発売日: 2015-12-25
  • スコア: 8.059999999999999/10 (324 人評価)
  • 日本語名: アマカノ～Second Season～
  • 英語名: Amakano Second Season

别名

  • Amakano 2

あらすじ

This is the second season of Amakano, with a new group of heroines in a similar winter setting. The protagonist came to the snowy town of Yomase to start a new life at the quiet inn Enki. Meeting the kind and cute, yet mischievous wheelchair-bound Kanade, the timid and earnest library committee member Yuzuka, and the cheerful and reliable student council leader Ruika helped him feel at ease in his new surroundings. However, there was another girl Honami who transferred on the same day, and she did not feel comfortable like he did. He wished to help her enjoy it, and that feeling would be the beginning of his love life.

item.title: Royal Garden ~Otome ni Koi Suru Ouji no Gikyoku~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Azarashi Soft
  • 発売日: 2015-10-30
  • スコア: 7.1/10 (42 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ロイヤルガーデン～乙女に恋する皇子の戯曲～
  • 英語名: Royal Garden Otome ni Koi Suru Ouji no Gikyoku

别名

  • ローデン

あらすじ

Life is a series of choices; one must make important decisions at various points in one’s life. Shinkurou is a poor guy barely getting by every day while troubled by debts. Yue is a dark-skinned maid who was tasked with a secret mission from her mother country Elgandia. They came together on the main street in the resort town Oumisaka, and she asked him to enrol for a year at Oumisaka Girl’s Private School as Yang, the Crown Prince of Elgandia.
